subject: Mythology
title: The Weighing of the Heart
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Weighing of the Heart.

hook.text: After death, every Egyptian faced the same terrifying trial: having their heart weighed on a golden scale.

buildup.text: Anubis placed the heart on one side and the feather of Ma'at — representing truth — on the other.

discovery.text: A heart heavy with lies, cruelty, or greed would outweigh the feather. A virtuous heart balanced perfectly.

twist.text: If you failed, the monster Ammit — part crocodile, lion, and hippo — devoured your heart on the spot.

climax.text: Those who passed entered the Field of Reeds, an eternal paradise of farming, feasting, and peace.

punchline.text: Eternity came down to whether your heart was lighter than a feather.

quiz.question: What happened if a heart was heavier than Ma'at's feather?
options: The soul was given a second chance to prove itself
The monster Ammit devoured the heart, destroying the soul
The soul was sent back to the living world
